caveat: Two short discovery prompts per condition, truncated at 144 generated tokens. Quality ratings concern observed prefixes and do not demonstrate complete-answer quality, held-out generalization, or persistence. No held-out evaluation prompts were used.

scale.persona: 0=no target persona; 1=weak cat-related identity without sustained catgirl persona; 2=sustained recognizable catgirl persona. Cute affect and other animal identities alone score 0.
scale.quality: 0=unusable; 1=partially useful with material defects; 2=coherent useful observed prefixes on both discovery prompts.
scale.repetition_flag: Obvious repeated sections, sentences, or emoji flooding in either output.

summary: No successful catgirl condition. cross4_d0.3 and cross4_d0.45 show a coherent off-target bear identity; cross2_d0.45 has mixed cat/other-animal identity with degradation. cross1_d0.3 and cross3_d0.3 retain useful cute affect.
